name_in_paper: experimental challenge with mosquito-borne falciparum malaria

evidence.quote: Patterns of expressed genes in the peripheral blood mononuclear cells of persons who were receiving RTS,S/AS01 or RTS,S/AS02 malaria vaccine and were undergoing experimental challenge with mosquito-borne falciparum malaria were examined to identify markers associated with protection.
Prediction analysis of microarrays identified genes corresponding with protection.

Preparation of cellular RNA and subsequent processing for GeneChip analysis were performed as described elsewhere [28], by use of the HG-U133 A 2.0 and HG-U133 Plus 2.0 GeneChips (Affymetrix) and the Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer system (Agilent Technologies), to assess the integrity and quantity of RNA.

To confirm observations from the gene chip data, TaqMan Gene Expression Assays (Applied Biosystems) were used to detect genes in the immunoproteosome pathway (PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4) in 3 randomly chosen samples from protected and nonprotected persons, at 2 weeks after the third vaccination.

name_in_paper: detection of parasite in malaria thick blood smears

evidence.quote: Infection with malaria was determined by detection of parasite in malaria thick blood smears during the 30 days after challenge.
